label: UFiber OLT 8
description: Ubiquiti UFiber UF-OLT GPON OLT, 1U fixed box (no card slots): 8 GPON SFP ports (2.488G down / 1.244G up, 128 ONUs per port, 1024 clients), 2x 10G SFP+ uplinks, 1 Ethernet out-of-band management port and 1 in-band Ethernet port = 12 ports. Layer-2 GPON core with 4062 VLANs.
